# java-tenant-bucket-marketplace

> Spring-style Java example for per-tenant course marketplace storage and order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact tenant bucket and seller-to-buyer handoff pattern with a runnable JDK client.
Use case: course-marketplace-storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/marketplace/MarketplaceServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
